snippet.text:
theorem wire (p : Permit M I a) {K : KernelChoices} {X : MapPrices} {l γ b}
    (hX : Next.Free.Catalog K X l γ b) (hk : P.kernelChoice G = K)
    (hF : P.flat = flatOf X)
    (hC : ∀ i, P.first ≤ i → (P.clip i).direct ≤ γ i)
    (hL : ∀ i, P.first ≤ i → b i ≤ f i) :
    ∃ B V : Horizon a, Wired P a X l B V := by
  have he : Next.Free.Credit a γ b := Next.Free.credit_from_sheet p.paid γ b hC hL
  obtain ⟨B,hR,hP,hB⟩ := delivered hX a (p.paid.kernel.trans hk) he
  rw [← hF] at hB
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hS⟩ := p.kernel hB
  obtain ⟨hm,hW⟩ := Next.Free.retained_presents a X B V hP hR hV
  exact ⟨B,V,hB,hR,hP,hV,hS,hm,hW⟩

proof_context.conclusion: `wire` takes `hC : ∀ i, P.first ≤ i → (P.clip i).direct ≤ γ i` and produces the horizon paths at every level.

snippet.text:
structure Billed (P : Before) (a : Levels G) (V : Horizon a) (N m : ℕ) (Q : PathData G) : Prop where
  placed : Attached (V.H N m) Q
  metric : Q.metric_zero (a.params m).clip
  top : let i := a.clock.J m; receipt Q (2 * (a.params m).width) (P.amount.born i)
  edge j : let i := a.clock.J m; StepStages j i → receipt Q (2 * (a.params m).width) (P.amount.sends j i)

proof_context.conclusion: `Billed` records `metric_zero` at the level clip and the row receipts, for each `m ≤ N`.

snippet.text:
first (N : ℕ) : ∃ R, StartsBudget P a N R ∧ Attached (V.H N N) R ∧ Ready N N R
  step N m : m < N → ∀ R, Ready N (m+1) R → Attached (V.H N (m+1)) R → Budgeted a (m+1) R →
    ∃ S, TransferPrices P a m R S ∧ Attached (V.H N m) S ∧ Ready N m S ∧ q N m R S

proof_context.conclusion: `first` builds the path data `R` at the top level `m=N` with `Attached`, and `step` produces the path data `S` at level `m` from the one at `m+1`, a descent from `N`.
